source.version: Part 12 — Trichomes and Cannabinoid Biosynthesis — Batch 03
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-231–235 were reconciled against the controlled Volume 12 manuscript plus direct CBDAS biochemistry, CBCAS mapping and oxidocyclase-function studies, varin inheritance and reconstructed-pathway evidence, cannabinoid acid/neutral analytical chemistry, and direct decarboxylation kinetics. Public wording separates synthase genotype from measured chemotype, minor-cannabinoid detection from proven dedicated pathways, varin biosynthesis from degradation, calculated totals from directly measured analytes, and decarboxylation science from operational processing recipes.
source.note: This batch completes the central oxidocyclase and acid-to-neutral chemistry sequence before Volume 12 turns to degradation, genotype-by-environment effects, developmental accumulation, field color observations, and claims discipline.
